{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nColumns:", data.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\")
print(data.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("\nNumber of unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Number of duplicates (rows per patient >1):", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for re-testing (sample_seq > 1)
print("\nNumber of patients with sample_seq > 1 (re-tested):", (data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max() > 1).sum())

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print("\nDistribution of arm:", data['arm'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("\nDistribution of severity:", data['severity'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check if responded is binary
print("\nUnique values in responded:", data['responded'].unique())"}
